skill.name: landing-experience-checker
skill.description: Preflight a paid campaign landing page against its ad copy, then produce a focused continuity and experience punch list before launch.
skill.summary: Checks ad-to-page continuity, mobile experience, form friction, and speed evidence before a paid campaign launches.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and repository-relative links. The documented scraper accepts a user-provided URL without stated destination controls, and the page-derived save filename lacks stated path sanitization. These risks require safeguards before automated use in a privileged environment.

remediation.issue: User-provided URLs are passed to a rendered-page scraper.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only http and https URLs, resolve and block private, loopback, link-local, and metadata IP ranges, validate every redirect, and run the fetcher with least network privilege.

remediation.issue: The saved report filename is derived from a page placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: Generate a slug with a strict character allowlist, resolve the final path, and reject any path outside the intended memory directory.

remediation.issue: The command example could be implemented through shell interpolation.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke the scraper with an argument array rather than a shell string, and treat the URL as data rather than executable text.

content.user_title: Preflight Your Landing Page Before Launch
content.value_statement: Paid campaigns can lose relevance when ad promises and landing pages do not match. This skill checks key experience signals and returns a clear pass, partial, or fix punch list.
actual_capabilities: Compares ad headlines and offers with landing-page claims.
Checks whether the offer and primary call to action appear above the fold.
Flags measured versus estimated speed and mobile-render evidence.
Counts required form fields and identifies visible friction points.
Creates a five-check punch list with Pass, Partial, or Fix labels.
Routes each confirmed issue to the appropriate follow-up skill.
limitations: It does not rewrite copy, redesign layouts, or modify forms.
It does not calculate Quality Score or approve campaign launch decisions.
Speed and mobile results are estimates when no measured export is supplied.
It needs landing-page content and ad copy to assess message continuity.

use_cases.title: Launch readiness review
use_cases.description: Compare a new campaign landing page with its final ad headlines before publishing.

use_cases.title: Low relevance diagnosis
use_cases.description: Identify likely landing-page experience gaps after an ad platform reports below-average relevance.

use_cases.title: Client handoff checklist
use_cases.description: Create a focused issue list for a web team without requesting a full page redesign.

prompt_templates.title: Basic preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Preflight this landing page against these ad headlines: [URL] [headlines].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with the required page and ad inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Offer continuity check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this page honors the offer in these ads. Mark each message-match issue Pass, Partial, or Fix: [URL] [ad copy].

prompt_templates.title: Experience review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a landing-page experience preflight for [URL]. Check above-the-fold offer, form friction, speed evidence, and mobile rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess the five core experience checks.

prompt_templates.title: Evidence-based handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this page copy, ad copy, and PageSpeed export, create a measured or estimated five-check punch list. Route every Fix to one owner: [materials].
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an actionable review for a delivery team.

output_examples.input: Preflight a product trial page against an ad that promises a 14-day free trial.
output: Message match: Pass. The trial promise appears in the headline and call to action.
Above the fold: Partial. The trial terms appear below the first viewport.
Form friction: Fix. The form requests six required fields before the trial starts.

output_examples.input: Review a page with ad copy and a PageSpeed export.
output: Speed: Measured. The export shows a slow loading experience that needs investigation.
Mobile: Partial. The offer is visible, but the primary call to action requires scrolling.
Handoff: Route page layout and form issues to the landing page owner.

best_practices: Provide the live ad copy, destination URL, and promised offer before starting.
Attach a recent PageSpeed or CrUX export when measured performance matters.
Label unavailable measurements as estimated and verify fixes with a second preflight.
anti_patterns: Do not treat estimated speed or mobile observations as measured results.
Do not use this skill to rewrite the page or calculate campaign Quality Score.
Do not request a continuity verdict when both page content and ad copy are unavailable.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks message match, above-the-fold content, speed evidence, form friction, and mobile rendering.

faq.question: Do I need both the page and ad copy?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill needs both to evaluate whether the landing page honors the ad promise.

faq.question: Does it change my landing page?
faq.answer: No. It reports gaps and routes repairs to the appropriate owner.

faq.question: Can it measure page speed?
faq.answer: It can use a supplied PageSpeed or CrUX export. Otherwise, it labels speed observations as estimates.

faq.question: Does it calculate Quality Score?
faq.answer: No. It identifies landing-page experience gaps but does not calculate platform Quality Score.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Paid media managers, performance marketers, and consultants preparing campaigns for launch.
